name: DCA Cocina Cucamonga QuesaBirria Tacos (Chili Consomé & Radish/Onion Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: Cocina Cucamonga Mexican Grill (San Fransokyo Square · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: While the braised beef is shredded and soft, the tacos are pan-fried in dried guajillo/ancho chili grease, stuffed with melted Monterey Jack, and served with a spicy red chili consomé, raw onions, and lime.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If ordering at Cocina Cucamonga during a flare or cautious day, skip the QuesaBirria and order the Kids' Pollo Asado Taco with plain rice instead.
watchOuts: High chili oil fat, raw chopped onions, lime juice (citrusFree: false), and dairy cheese
